settings.title: Three disciplines,
settings.intro: Most agencies are good at one thing. We're built to run the whole loop — so brand, demand, and web actually reinforce each other instead of fighting.

design.title: Brand strategy & identity
design.text: Positioning, messaging, and a visual system your market actually recognizes — built on research, not taste.

design.title: Messaging & voice
design.text: The words you use to win. We define the voice that carries through every page, post, and pitch.

build.title: Paid media
build.text: Search, social, and programmatic run on a strict CAC discipline. We scale what pays for itself and kill what doesn't.

build.title: Content & SEO
build.text: Assets that compound. We build the search and content engine that keeps qualified demand coming without renting it.

launch.title: Web & conversion
launch.text: Landing pages and sites engineered to convert — fast, on-brand, and tested against real visitor behavior.

launch.title: Lifecycle & retention
launch.text: Email, nurture, and onboarding that turn first buyers into repeat revenue instead of one-and-done.

settings.title: A process built on

steps.title: Diagnose
steps.text: We audit your funnel, your brand, and your data — and tell you where the leak is before we recommend spending a dollar.

steps.title: Strategize
steps.text: A plan with a target, a budget, and a projection. You see the thesis and the math before we commit anything.

steps.title: Execute
steps.text: Brand, paid, content, and web run in one cadence. Weekly standups, no black-box reporting.

steps.title: Optimize
steps.text: We reallocate to what's working every month and hold ourselves to the number we promised — not a pretty chart.

settings.note: Most engagements see a measurable lift in qualified pipeline within the first quarter. We stay on as long as we're earning the retainer.
